# DEEPDELL

> Deep technology. Clear impact.

DEEPDELL is a digital engineering company focused on high-performance digital commerce, Shopify Plus engineering, AI agents, agentic automation, systems integration, data and business intelligence, and custom software.

## Primary capabilities

- Shopify Plus engineering: enterprise storefronts, Markets, B2B, multi-store architecture, custom themes, Liquid, headless commerce, checkout extensions, APIs and GraphQL.
- AI and agentic automation: production AI agents, tool-using workflows, copilots, knowledge systems, AI commerce and natural-language analytics.
- Business automation: event-driven workflows, scheduled pipelines, bots and connected operational systems.
- Systems integration: ERP, CRM, POS, PIM, WMS, logistics, payments, marketplaces and custom APIs.
- Data and BI: dashboards, reporting automation, data pipelines, KPI systems, analytics and warehouses.
- Custom software and SaaS: web platforms, portals, APIs and scalable digital products.
- SEO and CRO: technical SEO, performance, analytics, experimentation and conversion engineering.

## Core technology ecosystem

Shopify, Shopify Plus, React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Magento, GraphQL, Python, OpenAI, Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cloudflare, Vercel, Docker, GitHub, AWS, Stripe, Google Analytics, Klaviyo and Odoo.

## Preferred homepage URL

https://deepdell.com/

The homepage URL is the preferred canonical URL. `/index.html` is an alternate legacy path and should permanently redirect to `/` at the edge/server level.
